title: Sley
summary: SLEY, noun A weaver's reed. [See Sleave and Sleid.] SLEY, verb transitive To separate; to part threads and arrange them in a reed; as weavers.

inlines.v: SLEY, noun A weaver's reed. [See Sleave and Sleid.] SLEY, verb transitive To separate; to part threads and arrange them in a reed; as weavers.
